clue.text: Charlie, more fashionable and cheerful

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
hipper means more trendy, more fashionable

explanation.surface: A man called Charlie is described as trendier and in good spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Chipper is an informal adjective for lively and in high spirits, a synonym of cheerful.

clue.text: Ornamental borders made from stucco are designed to convey height

indicators.note: to convey means to carry, so the rearranged letters hold the abbreviation inside them
designed means the letters are arranged into a new pattern

explanation.surface: Decorative frames are moulded from plaster to give a sense of height.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Made from' is a link here; 'to convey' works as carry, so the shuffled letters hold the height abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Cartouches are decorative scroll-shaped frames or tablets used as architectural ornament.

clue.text: Some nice 'n' interesting old British folk

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some ancient Britons were pleasant and engaging people.
explanation.definitionFit: The Iceni were a Celtic tribe of ancient East Anglia, led by Boudicca against Rome.

clue.text: Frontrunner from UN maybe lacking empathy at first

indicators.note: lacking means that letter is missing from the word for the UN

parts.note: the United Nations is an example of a body that brokers peace

indicators.note: at first selects the opening letter of empathy

explanation.surface: A leading candidate emerges from the United Nations, perhaps short on empathy initially.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacemaker in a race sets the speed by leading, a front-runner for others to follow.

clue.text: Quickly remove fleece?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to tear something off fast
second meaning: a swindle, as fleecing someone is overcharging them

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests pulling off a fleece jacket, but fleece here is the slang for cheating someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to tear away swiftly, and as a noun it is a swindle or overpriced deal.

clue.text: Regretting mostly creating havoc

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word is kept, its final letter dropped

parts.note: to rue is to regret, so regretting is ruing

explanation.surface: Someone full of regret has been wreaking destruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruin is a noun for wholesale destruction or devastation, which is what havoc means.

clue.text: Whistle-blower hiding up in safe room

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means those letters are read bottom to top
hiding says the letters sit concealed within the two words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An informant hides out in a secure room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whistle-blower' suggests an informant, but here it is the official who blows a whistle in a match.
explanation.definitionFit: A referee, shortened to ref, uses a whistle to stop play in football and other sports.

clue.text: Spaniard or Portuguese rotting in a bier

indicators.note: rotting suggests decay and breakdown, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A corpse from Spain or Portugal decays on a funeral stand.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain and Portugal share the Iberian Peninsula, so a native of either is an Iberian.

clue.text: Eggs are too set in the middle always

indicators.note: the centre letter is taken from each of the three words every time, as always suggests

explanation.surface: A cook complains that eggs end up too firm in the centre every time.
explanation.definitionFit: Roe is the mass of eggs inside a female fish, a familiar food.

clue.text: Drink and face up to getting smashed

indicators.note: smashed suggests these letters are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone resorts to drink to confront problems, and gets drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smashed' reads as drunk, fitting the drink, but it signals rearranging the letters of FACE UP TO.
explanation.definitionFit: A cup of tea is a drink, the British staple beverage.

clue.text: Nominally, Naomi worked with Lenny

indicators.note: worked means the letters are shaped or kneaded into a new form

explanation.surface: Naomi collaborated with Lenny, though only on paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A title held in name only is nominal, existing as a label without real substance.

clue.text: Disapproval results from quietly leaving stage

indicators.note: leaving says the letter for quietly departs from the word for stage

parts.note: a podium is a raised platform or stage
P is piano, the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A performer walks off silently and is met with disapproval.
explanation.definitionFit: Odium is general hatred or strong public condemnation, a strong form of disapproval.

clue.text: Heads of firms often hold sway overseas

indicators.note: heads are the front letters of each of the following words

parts.note: to reign is to rule or hold sway

explanation.surface: Bosses of companies frequently dominate abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Foreign describes something abroad or from another country, as overseas does.

clue.text: Proper strategy to go after answer immediately

indicators.note: to go after means the word for strategy follows the abbreviation for answer

parts.note: right means correct or proper
a way is a method or strategy

explanation.surface: The correct approach is to pursue a solution.
explanation.definitionFit: Right away is an idiom meaning at once, without delay.

clue.text: Express sorrow about each book finally showing signs of age?

indicators.note: about means the word for expressing sorrow goes around the other letters

parts.note: to cry is to express sorrow

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of book

explanation.surface: Someone weeps over each volume as it shows its age.
explanation.definitionFit: Something creaky, like old joints or floorboards, is worn and decrepit; the question mark marks this as an example rather than a synonym.

clue.text: English married couple have a cuddle

parts.note: a brace is a pair or couple, as of game birds

explanation.surface: An English newlywed pair hug each other.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace is to hug, holding someone in your arms.

clue.text: Plan from ace American lawyer containing information

indicators.note: containing means the ace and the lawyer surround the word for information

parts.note: A is the card abbreviation for ace
a DA is a District Attorney, an American prosecutor
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A top American attorney's scheme involves inside information.
explanation.walkthrough: Gen is informal British for information, as in 'get the gen'.
explanation.definitionFit: An agenda is a list of items to be discussed, a programme or plan of action.

clue.text: Clothes left out for friend from Australia

indicators.note: out means the letter for left is removed

parts.note: clobber is British slang for clothes or gear

explanation.surface: Clothing is laid out for a mate visiting from Down Under.
explanation.walkthrough: Clobber is British slang for clothes, belongings or gear.
explanation.definitionFit: Cobber is Australian slang for a mate or companion.

clue.text: Trade stoppage thus limits a degree of business

indicators.note: limits means the word for thus forms the bounds around the degree

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore, thus
an MBA is a Master of Business Administration degree

explanation.surface: Commercial restrictions curb the value of a business qualification.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban on commerce with a particular country, halting trade.

clue.text: Sample artworks latterly stored in gallery

indicators.note: stored in means that letter is placed inside the gallery's name

parts.note: the Tate is a famous group of London art galleries

indicators.note: latterly points to the last letter of artworks

explanation.surface: Examples of art kept recently in a gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tate is a group of British national art galleries, including Tate Modern in London.
explanation.definitionFit: To taste food is to try or sample a little of it.

clue.text: Calm, all the same

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as a calm person who is unchanged, but the two parts are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes quiet unmoving water and also serves as an adverb meaning nevertheless.

clue.text: Acknowledge the audience and prepare to play the cello?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: bend forward to accept applause
second meaning: pick up the stick strung with horsehair used on a cello

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading needs the noun bow, rhyming with 'go', not the bending one.
explanation.definitionFit: Performers bend at the waist after a show to thank applause, and a cellist must lift the stringed stick before playing.

clue.text: I try to follow enthusiastically at the beginning

indicators.note: to follow means the word for try comes after that letter
at the beginning picks the opening letter of enthusiastically

parts.note: a go is an attempt or try

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to keep up with eager effort from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I' reads as the speaker, but it is the definition: the self.
explanation.definitionFit: Ego is Latin for the first-person pronoun and names the conscious self.

clue.text: Popular new place for an overnight stay

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A trendy fresh spot for a one-night stopover.
explanation.definitionFit: An inn is a pub or small hotel offering lodging to travellers for the night.

clue.text: Protest using a string of placard emojis

indicators.note: string of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Demonstrators make their point with a row of emoji symbols on a sign.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition 'Protest using' cannot stand in for the answer; the definition is just 'Protest', and 'using a' is link.
explanation.definitionFit: A demo is short for demonstration, a public march or rally to object to something.

clue.text: Initially, rookie or youth, associate with great style

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the next three words

parts.note: an ally is an associate or partner

explanation.surface: A new recruit or young person teams up with someone in fine fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Royally means in a manner fit for a monarch, splendidly or magnificently.
